# Settings reference

What your CSMS can read and change on a charger, with the defaults, generated from the code.

## OCPP 2.0.1 device model

A CSMS reads and writes these with `GetVariables` / `SetVariables` / `GetBaseReport`; you can also edit the read-write ones in the **Device model** tab. 106 variables for the default two-EVSE charger. Changes apply at once.

## OCPP 1.6 configuration keys

A 1.6 charger has configuration keys instead of a device model. A CSMS reads and writes them with `GetConfiguration` / `ChangeConfiguration`; the **Device model** tab is then called *Configuration keys*. Keys backed by a device model variable change real behaviour.

| Key | Access | Type | Backed by | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AllowOfflineTxForUnknownId` | read-write | bool | `AuthCtrlr.OfflineTxForUnknownIdEnabled` |  |
| `AuthorizationCacheEnabled` | read-write | bool | `AuthCacheCtrlr.Enabled` |  |
| `AuthorizeRemoteTxRequests` | read-write | bool | `AuthCtrlr.AuthorizeRemoteStart` |  |
| `ClockAlignedDataInterval` | read-write | int | `AlignedDataCtrlr.Interval` |  |
| `ConnectionTimeOut` | read-write | int | `TxCtrlr.EVConnectionTimeOut` |  |
| `ConnectorPhaseRotation` | read-write | csl |  | `NotApplicable` |
| `GetConfigurationMaxKeys` | read-only | int |  | `99` |
| `HeartbeatInterval` | read-write | int | `OCPPCommCtrlr.HeartbeatInterval` |  |
| `LocalAuthorizeOffline` | read-write | bool | `AuthCtrlr.LocalAuthorizeOffline` |  |
| `LocalPreAuthorize` | read-write | bool | `AuthCtrlr.LocalPreAuthorize` |  |
| `MeterValuesAlignedData` | read-write | csl | `AlignedDataCtrlr.Measurands` |  |
| `MeterValuesSampledData` | read-write | csl | `SampledDataCtrlr.TxUpdatedMeasurands` |  |
| `MeterValueSampleInterval` | read-write | int | `SampledDataCtrlr.TxUpdatedInterval` |  |
| `MinimumStatusDuration` | read-write | int |  | `0` |
| `NumberOfConnectors` | read-only | int | number of connectors |  |
| `ResetRetries` | read-write | int |  | `1` |
| `StopTransactionOnEVSideDisconnect` | read-write | bool |  | `true` |
| `StopTransactionOnInvalidId` | read-write | bool |  | `true` |
| `StopTxnAlignedData` | read-write | csl | `AlignedDataCtrlr.TxEndedMeasurands` |  |
| `StopTxnSampledData` | read-write | csl | `SampledDataCtrlr.TxEndedMeasurands` |  |
| `SupportedFeatureProfiles` | read-only | csl |  | `Core,FirmwareManagement,LocalAuthListManagement,Reservation,SmartCharging,RemoteTrigger` |
| `TransactionMessageAttempts` | read-write | int |  | `3` |
| `TransactionMessageRetryInterval` | read-write | int |  | `60` |
| `UnlockConnectorOnEVSideDisconnect` | read-write | bool |  | `true` |
| `WebSocketPingInterval` | read-write | int | `OCPPCommCtrlr.WebSocketPingInterval` |  |
| `LocalAuthListEnabled` | read-write | bool | `LocalAuthListCtrlr.Enabled` |  |
| `LocalAuthListMaxLength` | read-only | int | `LocalAuthListCtrlr.Storage` |  |
| `SendLocalListMaxLength` | read-only | int |  | `100` |
| `ReserveConnectorZeroSupported` | read-only | bool | `ReservationCtrlr.NonEvseSpecific` |  |
| `ChargeProfileMaxStackLevel` | read-only | int |  | `99` |
| `ChargingScheduleAllowedChargingRateUnit` | read-only | csl |  | `Current,Power` |
| `ChargingScheduleMaxPeriods` | read-only | int |  | `24` |
| `ConnectorSwitch3to1PhaseSupported` | read-only | bool |  | `false` |
| `MaxChargingProfilesInstalled` | read-only | int | `SmartChargingCtrlr.EntriesChargingProfiles` |  |

## Vehicles

| Key | Vehicle | Battery | AC | DC | Can feed back (V2G) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `city` | City EV | 30 kWh | 7.4 kW | 50 kW | no |
| `mid` | Mid-size EV | 60 kWh | 11 kW | 100 kW | 10 kW |
| `large` | Large EV | 100 kWh | 11 kW | 150 kW | 20 kW |
| `scooter` | E-scooter | 3 kWh | 1.5 kW | no DC | no |

## Hardware presets

| Key | Charger |
|---|---|
| `ac_7` | AC wallbox · 7.4 kW · 1 connector |
| `ac_22_dual` | AC pedestal · 2 × 22 kW |
| `dc_60_dual` | DC fast · 2 × 60 kW (CCS2 + CHAdeMO on one EVSE) |
| `dc_150` | DC ultra-fast · 150 kW · CCS2 |
| `mixed_hub` | Hub · 2 AC 22 kW + 1 DC 60 kW |
